INSERT INTO workspace_diff (source_workspace_id, fork_workspace_id, path, kind, ahead, behind, has_changes, fork_last_event_kind, fork_last_event_origin)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 1, 0, NULL, $5, $6)
            ON CONFLICT (source_workspace_id, fork_workspace_id, path, kind)
            DO UPDATE SET
                ahead = workspace_diff.ahead + 1,
                has_changes = NULL,
                fork_last_event_kind = EXCLUDED.fork_last_event_kind,
                fork_last_event_origin = EXCLUDED.fork_last_event_origin
